items.title: A trip down Market Street before the fire (Miles Brothers, filmed 14 April 1906; Library of Congress viewing copy, 9 minutes 39 seconds, silent): one unbroken ride down San Francisco's main street on the front of a cable car
items.license: Public domain, as the source page states it: "The contents of the Library of Congress Before and After the Great Earthquake and Fire: Early Films of San Francisco, 1897 to 1916 Collection are in the public domain and are free to use and reuse." A silent film (the file carries one audio track of digital silence). The project uses the film as the source page publishes it, relying on that statement.
